sloka: भरतस्तु रथस्थ: सन् श्रीमान् दशरथात्मज: ।वाहयन्तं रथश्रेष्ठं सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥ २.११४.२१॥
transliteration: bharatastu rathastha: san śrīmān daśarathātmaja: ।vāhayantaṁ rathaśreṣṭhaṁ sārathiṁ vākyamabravīt ॥ 2.114.21॥

translations.english: Illustrious Bharata, son of Dasaratha, seated in his chariot, addressed the charioteer as he drove the most excellent of chariots saying:
translations.hindi: कोयेन कुरुते पायं मनसा संप्रधायं च । ८ है ८ ९ अनृतं जिह्वया चाह त्रिविधं कम पातकम्‌
